quotes.text: I've had people tell me the guitar solo on that record changed their life, and I genuinely cannot remember recording it. I'm not being modest — I think I was watching a football game in my head and my hands just went.

quotes.context: Rolling Stone 50th Anniversary oral history feature, published November 2017

quotes.context: Paris Match interview, translated and reprinted in MOJO magazine, February 2002

quotes.text: There's a moment in the studio — I don't know if every producer feels this — where the track kind of tells you it's done, and you keep poking at it anyway because you paid for the time. That's how you ruin half the good songs that never get released.
quotes.speaker: Rick Rubin
quotes.context: Broken Record podcast with Malcolm Gladwell, episode aired March 2022
